entities.name: Query RlmN protein
observations: 364 aa; calculated molecular mass 39.6 kDa and theoretical pI 8.25.
Strong homology support: 83.9% identity and 97.5% query coverage to reviewed Gemmatimonas aurantiaca RlmN (UniProt C1A949; E-value 8.22e-216).
Pfam domains: RlmN_N at residues 10–69 and Radical_SAM at residues 116–273.
Sequence contains the characteristic cysteine-rich region supporting binding of one [4Fe-4S] cluster; exact ligand assignment is inferred from homologs.
Likely cytoplasmic dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase targeting 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate RlmN as EC 2.1.1.192, a dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase.
Catalyzes radical-SAM-dependent C2 methylation of A2503 in 23S rRNA and A37 in tRNA, using S-adenosyl-L-methionine and a [4Fe-4S] cluster.
Annotated as cytoplasmic, with rRNA/tRNA binding and roles in rRNA base methylation and tRNA methylation.

entities.name: RlmN Fe-S cofactor
observations: RlmN binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and an exchangeable SAM ligand, according to reviewed homolog annotations.
The radical-SAM chemistry generates 5'-deoxyadenosine and methylated RNA products; detailed stoichiometry is database-mapped rather than experimentally established for this query sequence.
